title: Which Value an Amended Catering Order Carries into a Cancellation
content:
An order under a Corporate Catering Service Agreement that has been amended may carry the amended value, a value reset from the amended guest count, or the value it was placed at.

**Where an amendment entry stands on the order and the guest count has been reduced by no more than the free reduction band standing on the order**, the value the most recent amendment entry records stands.

**Where an amendment entry stands on the order, the guest count has been reduced beyond the free reduction band standing on the order and that amendment was asked for no later than the guest count deadline printed against the catering service level, counted in whole days from the day the amendment was asked for to the service day and taken at 24 hours to the day**, the value is reset to the amended guest count at the per-guest rate the order was placed at.

**Otherwise**, the value the order was placed at stands.

### The two quantities the branches turn on

The reduction in guest count is the guest count the order was placed at less the guest count the most recent amendment entry records, expressed as a percentage of the guest count the order was placed at and taken to two decimal places. The per-guest rate the order was placed at is the value the order was placed at divided by the guest count it was placed at; the reset value is that rate multiplied by the amended guest count, taken to two decimal places.

### Cases on hypothetical figures

An order placed at 2000.00 USD on 100 guests, amended to 85 guests at 1800.00 USD, where the free reduction band standing on the order is 10.0 per cent and the guest count deadline printed against the service level is 48 hours:

| The amendment | Value carried |
| --- | --- |
| Reduction of 15.00 per cent, amendment asked for 3 days before the service day (72 hours) | 1700.00 USD, being the per-guest rate of 20.00 USD on 85 guests |
| Reduction of 15.00 per cent, amendment asked for 1 day before the service day (24 hours) | 2000.00 USD |
| Reduction of 8.00 per cent, whenever asked for | the value the most recent amendment entry records |
| No amendment entry on the order | 2000.00 USD |

An amendment asked for exactly 2 days before the service day holds 48 hours, which is no later than a deadline of 48 hours, so it is on the second branch.
